status: AUTHORING ONLY, current v0.5.5 proposed defaults; supersedes earlier producer proposals. No engine changes or runtime pass claimed.

policy.status: CURRENT RECONCILED AUTHORING DRAFT, aligned to live milestone-2-spec v0.5.5 §12.6.6.1. Supersedes numeric-only v0.5.3, initial curiosity-only proposal and v0.5.4 wording. Still PROPOSED DEFAULT, not a runtime pass.
policy.purpose: One stored ruling controls the Bonefield-topic border branch. Ford changes faction history; leader review reads it and commits a separate decision. Scene does not run a competing live numeric selector.
policy.proposalForTundra: Uses current v0.5.5 proposed defaults exactly. No curiosity override of known feud/negative standing, no unrelated-introduction block, no new numeric effects from a ruling.

doesNotCover: Unrelated requests to meet Highcrag’s leader
Player romance, personal affection or pride admission
scope.applicant: Bind requesting player ID; player-standing causes are not evidence of a whole-pride feud.

normalRoute.entry: At an ordinary legal Highcrag border meeting with unknown policy, add authored request_policy_review choice. Requires current topic explicitly concerns Bonefield; general requests must not be blocked by unrelated faction policy.

choices.label: “Ask your leader whether you may carry requests involving Bonefield.”
choices.effect: Commit one review request, naming player, guard and current Highcrag leader. No policy value yet.

choices.label: “Leave it for now.”
choices.effect: No review request or policy write.

normalRoute.entry: At next eligible day-resolution after hazards, using existing event budget; never interrupt pendingArc. Persist request/latch if occupied, with no forced time skip.
normalRoute.effect: Commit the guard’s actual relay to the current living leader, with request-source provenance. This teaches that recipient the petition only, not private player history. If leader unavailable, keep unresolved; no substitute, synthetic relay or invented old policy.

normalRoute.entry: A subsequent eligible border review scene explicitly brings the leader, reporting guard and player together at the legal meeting site. Save these actual attendee IDs; use their current saved names, portraits and all five traits. This is a new on-screen meeting, not a claim that an earlier request already guaranteed an audience.
normalRoute.effect: Leader responds on-screen; permit/defer is the leader’s committed ruling, not the player editing faction data.

normalRoute.entry: After the ruling and its scoped knowledge commit, resume/offer the existing border introduction request for the same Bonefield topic.
normalRoute.effect: Permitted offers send_request; deferred offers explanation/withdrawal. Persist selected branch/policy version/source and exact speech/choices before display. No replay cost.

decisionProposal.requiredData: Before rendering any speaker or committing their ruling, all five saved traits and actual identity must be available. Otherwise preserve pending review and flag unresolved characterization, even if a numeric condition appears decisive.
decisionProposal.scopeFirst: If topic.prideId != bonefield, bypass this entire policy and feud test. Existing unrelated introduction rules apply.

firstMatchWins.when: Highcrag->Bonefield <= -15 AND leader knows an applicable source event
firstMatchWins.cause: verified applicable feud source event ID
standing record/version; do not invent an offense
leader decision citing saved trait snapshot and no higher-priority blocker

decisionProposal.authority: Only this committed ruling is consumed by the border scene. No simultaneous derived-policy store or numeric-only scene gate. Missing ruling stays unanswered until the request/relay/review route commits it.
decisionProposal.repetition: A curiosity/caution deferral may be re-reviewed through the same request route after borderRepetitionDays=5. A known-feud or negative-standing deferral cannot be bypassed by curiosity or repetition alone; its cause must change. A new reviewed decision supersedes the old version.
decisionProposal.noNumericEffects: Ruling itself adds no faction, standing, personal or romance delta. Neither a permit nor warm standing grants entry, food, membership or guaranteed future agreement.

commitContract.worldEvent: Policy ruling event records requestEventId, relayEventId, source leader/guard IDs, from/to pride IDs, policy kind, permit_relay/defer_relay, optional real cause fact IDs, sourceAbsDay and monotonic version.
commitContract.policyWrite: Persist only the scoped Highcrag->Bonefield ruling, applicant, decision cause and version from this actual leader-decision event. Ford numeric edges remain independent and are never overwritten by the ruling.
commitContract.knowledge: Leader, reporting guard and player actually present learn the exact ruling through this event. No automatic all-cat/pride-wide publicity. A different guard needs a subsequent actual instruction/relay or the normal explicitly enabled knowledge rule.
commitContract.atomicity: Ruling event + directional policy version + attendee knowledge + receipt + next cursor in one commit. Receipt must include run/request/decision identity; reload or a second witness cannot write it again.
commitContract.pendingContinue: Before ruling, policy stays unknown and request stays pending. After ruling, restore same version, speaker traits, presented lines and choices. No second decision on load.
commitContract.precedence: Superseding policy requires a new explicit ruling with version and cause. Preserve old event/history. An unfinished exchange stays pinned to its displayed source or pauses for an explicit revalidation, not a silent branch swap.
commitContract.legacy: Missing policy/knowledge remains unknown. Never retroactively claim the leader spoke. Normal request/relay/review route can create the first actual ruling.
commitContract.versionRefresh: New Ford/standing facts are inputs to a NEW review, not a silent edit to a saved ruling or pending branch. To demonstrate post-Ford deferral, ordinary play must actually relay/know the source and commit the new leader review. Pin the source ruling/version on pending dialogue.

checks: Ordinary new-game route reaches request -> relay -> actual on-screen ruling -> policy-dependent border choice; no debug setter or seeded hostility.
Hold every other input fixed and change only Bonefield->Highcrag: no branch change.
Permitted ruling produces send_request and audience_offered; deferred ruling produces explanation/withdrawal and audience_deferred, both tied to saved cause/version.
If leader lacks knowledge of a recorded conflict, leader may not name it. If guard knows policy but not private aid, guard never mentions the aid.
A deferral due to caution never becomes a historical feud, hostile numeric stance or accusation.
Different unknown guard does not magically inherit ruling knowledge; an actual order relay must be recorded.
Save before ruling, after ruling, and mid-border response; exact speaker/trait/line/choice state survives and effects apply once.
All player exits remain present; asking for a review does not resolve return_quiet, promise an audience, grant passage or duplicate daily costs.
Missing required traits remains an explicit character gap, not a baseline-only success.
Warm standing plus known feud still defers; warm standing plus no known feud permits even for curiosity<50.
Negative standing plus high curiosity still defers.
Unrelated request ignores both Bonefield ruling and numeric edge.
Changing only the numeric edge cannot silently rewrite a committed/pending ruling; the proof must execute an actual informed review.

personalityCoverage.policyRef: Revision6 personalityCoverage render/action/relationship precedence, applied to EACH CURRENT SPEAKER, not ln05 or the player. All five saved traits mandatory. Store exact variant/action and node for Continue. Context action tables inherited; no new trait mechanics.

unknown_offer.speaker: guard
unknown_offer.base: I do not have an instruction about carrying requests involving Bonefield. I can ask.
unknown_offer.high: I can ask our leader about carrying that request. Stay outside our boundary while it waits.
unknown_offer.low: I do not have that instruction. I can ask, but wait outside our boundary.

review_requested.speaker: guard
review_requested.base: I will ask about that request. I have not promised an answer.
review_requested.high: I will carry that question as you gave it. Do not count it as an answer yet.
review_requested.low: I can ask the question. I am not making a promise about the answer.

leader_open.speaker: leader
leader_open.base: You asked whether requests involving Bonefield may be carried. I have heard that question.
leader_open.high: I have heard your request. I will give the instruction here, so there is no guessing.
leader_open.low: I have heard the question. Let us be clear about what is being asked before anyone carries a request.
leader_open.requires: actual request and relay event; leader present

leader_permit.speaker: leader
leader_permit.base: Requests involving Bonefield may be brought to me. Hearing one is not agreeing to it.
leader_permit.high: Bring me those requests. I want to hear what is being asked before deciding.
leader_permit.low: You may carry the request to me. Keep it to the matter being asked; hearing it grants nothing.
leader_permit.requires: committed permit_relay decision; no claim of peace

leader_defer_caution.speaker: leader
leader_defer_caution.base: Hold requests involving Bonefield for now. That is a delay, not a declaration of a feud.
leader_defer_caution.high: Hold them for now. I will not let an unclear invitation become a promise on my pride’s behalf.
leader_defer_caution.low: Hold them for now. I am not binding our pride to an arrangement simply by receiving a petition.
leader_defer_caution.requires: committed defer_relay decision without verified conflict cause

leader_defer_cause.speaker: leader
leader_defer_cause.base: That unresolved matter must be dealt with first. Hold those requests for now.
leader_defer_cause.high: That matter is not settled. Hold the requests; I will not pretend we have passed it.
leader_defer_cause.low: That matter remains unsettled. Let us hold the requests rather than imply it is resolved.
leader_defer_cause.requires: committed defer_relay; leader knows actual applicable source event. Attach source-event summary only from verified fact, never authored invented incident.

guard_permitted.speaker: guard
guard_permitted.base: The instruction permits me to carry your request. What should I tell our leader?
guard_permitted.high: I can carry it under that instruction. Tell me what you want our leader to hear.
guard_permitted.low: I can carry this request. Say plainly what you want me to pass on.
guard_permitted.requires: guard knows current permit version; player standing gate separately passes

guard_deferred_known_aid.speaker: guard
guard_deferred_known_aid.base: I know about your help to a Bonefield cat, and I have the instruction to wait. You can give your account; I cannot promise an introduction.
guard_deferred_known_aid.high: I know about that help. Tell me your account if you want it heard, but do not mistake that for an introduction.
guard_deferred_known_aid.low: I know about that help. You may explain it, but the instruction still leaves the request waiting.
guard_deferred_known_aid.requires: guard knows current defer version AND actual verified aid event involving Bonefield; aid knowledge is not evidence that the aid caused policy

guard_deferred_no_aid.speaker: guard
guard_deferred_no_aid.base: The instruction is to hold these requests. I am not carrying this one today.
guard_deferred_no_aid.high: The instruction is to wait. I will not carry it today.
guard_deferred_no_aid.low: I have the instruction to wait. I cannot offer to carry it today.
guard_deferred_no_aid.requires: guard knows current defer version; private aid knowledge absent

guard_unknown.speaker: guard
guard_unknown.base: I do not have an answer about that request.
guard_unknown.high: I do not have an instruction yet. We can ask what is allowed; I will not guess.
guard_unknown.low: I have no answer to give. I will not promise one.
guard_unknown.requires: no known applicable policy; never asserts a secret ruling

account_request.speaker: guard
account_request.high: Tell me what happened, and what you actually saw.
account_request.low: Give me the account plainly. I will not fill in what you leave out.
account_request.requires: actual explanation choice; no forced private disclosure

verified_disclosure.speaker: guard
verified_disclosure.base: I have heard your account. The request still waits.
verified_disclosure.high: I have heard it. I will keep your account separate from what the instruction allows.
verified_disclosure.low: I have heard what you chose to tell me. It does not settle the request.
verified_disclosure.requires: actual verified disclosure; learns exact source only, not all private history

keep_private.speaker: guard
keep_private.high: Keep it private, then. I will not treat silence as an explanation or as guilt.
keep_private.low: You need not tell me more. The request still has no answer.

relay_accepted.speaker: guard
relay_accepted.base: At the border, not inside the den. I will pass that request on.
relay_accepted.high: At the border. I will carry that request, not promise what the answer will be.
relay_accepted.low: I can pass on a request to meet at the border. No answer is promised.
relay_accepted.requires: send_request committed under known permitted policy; audience_offered means relay accepted only

withdraw.speaker: guard
withdraw.base: All right. The request stops here.
withdraw.high: All right. I will leave it there; you need not stay for my sake.
withdraw.low: All right. I will not carry a withdrawn request.
withdraw.requires: player withdrawal only; no policy, standing, cost or promise write

leader_defer_standing.speaker: leader
leader_defer_standing.base: I am not receiving this petition from you today.
leader_defer_standing.high: I will not receive this petition from you today. Do not mistake hearing the question for accepting it.
leader_defer_standing.low: I am not ready to receive this petition from you. We will leave it unanswered today.
leader_defer_standing.requires: committed standing-caused deferral; no invented offense or feud

leader_permit_warm.speaker: leader
leader_permit_warm.base: You may bring the request. I will hear what is being asked.
leader_permit_warm.high: Bring the request to me. I would rather hear it plainly than leave you waiting.
leader_permit_warm.low: You may carry the request. I will hear that matter; no more is promised.
leader_permit_warm.requires: committed warm-standing permit; no higher-priority known feud/negative standing

personalityCoverage.moderate: Focus31..69 uses the complete base response; data absence is not moderate.
personalityCoverage.playerChoices: Keep player-authored intent and exits; NPC personality shapes the response/instruction and visible behavior, never rewrites the player.

policy.rulesSource: docs/design/milestone-2-spec.md v0.5.5 §12.6.6.1–4, read live 2026-11-07; no commit SHA assumed beyond supplied v0.5.4 8ad5c07.

normalPlayProofs.curious: Before the Ford dispute, neutral-standing player requests review; curious leader permits. Later visit Greywater Ford on absDay>=2; actual incident and knowledge are recorded; re-petition/review now commits known-feud defer. Keep personal values fixed when comparing the policy consequence.
normalPlayProofs.cautious: Before triggering Ford, initial neutral petition may defer from caution. Earn Highcrag standing>=+15 through existing legitimate play, wait the proposed 5-day re-petition interval, then request/review for permit. A later Ford incident followed by informed review provides defer. Do NOT claim this route is independently proven or that visiting Ford first can be cured with personal warmth.
normalPlayProofs.noFalseRecovery: After a known Ford feud, warm standing does NOT override priority1. The Ford source does not decay in M2; recovery requires the separate pride-level event defined by Tundra, not a promise that talking will erase it.

fordStory.status: DRAFT story text aligned to v0.5.5 §12.6.6.2; no new costs, injuries, combat, food award or art.
fordStory.trigger: First actual Greywater Ford visit on absDay>=2, once per run. Both living adult pride representatives and all five saved traits required; no substituted default characters.
fordStory.openingNarration: At the edge of Greywater Ford, a carcass catches against the stones. {highcragCatName} stands on the bank while {bonefieldCatName} braces against the water beside it. Neither gives way.
fordStory.factBoundary: The ford is Highcrag-held and disputed by Bonefield per map-v1. Do not state who killed the prey or that a leader ordered this encounter. It is a new witnessed dispute, not a recollection of a starting war.
fordStory.fixedEvent: Commit the observed incident once with runId/ford_dispute/highcrag/bonefield. Highcrag->Bonefield -20, Bonefield->Highcrag -10; sourceType hunt_steal, pride_known to both, not world_known. Pin two actual participant IDs. Choice receipt is separate; Save/Continue cannot replay incident delta.

choices.label: Help the Bonefield cat pull the carcass clear of the current.
choices.effect: Bonefield cat->player +5. Record player_aided_bonefield, with Highcrag participant as actual witness. No faction delta from choice; no automatic ownership or player food award.

choices.label: Stand beside the Highcrag cat and ask the Bonefield cat to leave the prey.
choices.effect: Highcrag cat->player +5. Record mirror sided-with-Highcrag fact with Bonefield participant as witness. No faction delta from choice; no auto fight or claim that the demand was obeyed.

choices.label: Keep clear and let the two cats settle their own dispute.
choices.effect: No personal delta. Record actual observation/choice only; do not imply support for either pride.

fordStory.knowledge: The dispute source is pride_known to both by Tundra rule; the player’s choice is a SEPARATE witnessed/private fact. Aid fact reaches other Highcrag members only through explicit disclosure/relay or the enabled 3-day rumor rule. Numeric faction delta alone does not teach a guard the player’s deed.
fordStory.ending: The argument remains unsettled when you move away. The recorded incident is the faction cause; no truce, victory, prey transfer, injury or promised retaliation is silently added.
fordStory.personalityPolicyRef: Revision6 full required speaker data, low/high focus and contextual action policy. For EACH speaking cat use its own saved traits/name/portrait, with exact selected line/action restored on Continue. Player choice labels are player intentions, not NPC personality.

highcrag_open.speaker: highcragCat
highcrag_open.base: Leave it. This bank is Highcrag ground.
highcrag_open.high: Leave it where it is. You are on Highcrag ground.
highcrag_open.low: You are on Highcrag ground. Leave the prey here rather than make this worse.

bonefield_answer.speaker: bonefieldCat
bonefield_answer.base: I am not letting it wash away while we argue.
bonefield_answer.high: I will get it clear of the water. I am not backing away because you tell me to.
bonefield_answer.low: It is slipping. Let me get it clear before either of us makes this a fight.

aid_bonefield_response.speaker: bonefieldCat
aid_bonefield_response.base: Help me get it onto the stones.
aid_bonefield_response.high: Here, beside me. We can pull it out of the current together.
aid_bonefield_response.low: Pull from there. That is enough help; you need not come closer.

aid_highcrag_response.speaker: highcragCat
aid_highcrag_response.base: You helped move it. That does not settle the dispute.
aid_highcrag_response.high: Moving it does not decide who may take it. Do not pretend it does.
aid_highcrag_response.low: You kept it from washing away. We still have not settled who takes it.

side_highcrag_response.speaker: highcragCat
side_highcrag_response.base: Stay beside me. We are asking them to leave it, not promising a fight.
side_highcrag_response.high: Stand with me, then. Keep to what we have asked; do not turn it into a promise to fight.
side_highcrag_response.low: Stand there if you want. I have not asked you to commit to anything beyond this.

side_bonefield_response.speaker: bonefieldCat
side_bonefield_response.base: Standing together does not settle this.
side_bonefield_response.high: Two cats asking does not make it settled. I have not agreed to leave it.
side_bonefield_response.low: You have both asked. That does not mean I have agreed.

stay_highcrag_response.speaker: highcragCat
stay_highcrag_response.base: Keep clear, then. This is still between us.
stay_highcrag_response.high: You can keep clear. I would rather you stayed to hear us than stepped into a fight.
stay_highcrag_response.low: Keep clear. I will speak for myself.

stay_bonefield_response.speaker: bonefieldCat
stay_bonefield_response.base: Then do not speak for either of us.
stay_bonefield_response.high: Then hear what each of us says before you decide what happened here.
stay_bonefield_response.low: Then leave the argument to us. You need not question me.
